Both pathways involve the enzyme as a target of a compound that ultimately affects the kinase. The evidence is supported by a moderate score (0.7494) in the first pathway and a slightly lower score (0.696) in the second, indicating some level of confidence in the relationship. The mechanisms involve the enzyme acting as a target of a drug or viral antigen, which then modulates the kinase. The integration of these pathways suggests that the enzyme may play a role in signaling pathways that are influenced by both cellular and viral factors, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct interaction.
